messages:
priya: FYI customer #acme reported spikes of 5xx and API timeouts to hosted inference in eu-west since ~09:45 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Error sample attached.
jamie: I'm on it. Can you paste a few request IDs and whether they hit dedicated vs hosted?
priya: Request IDs: rq_3a7f, rq_3a8b, rq_3a9c. All reported through hosted (no dedicated). Customer says some calls returned 502, others timed out after 30s.
nate: seeing increased 502s from gateway in eu-west: logs show upstream 504 from inference-runtime pool-7. quick grep: 
```
2023-11-02T09:46:12Z gateway ERROR upstream_status=504 pool=runtime-pool-7 model=redwood-v0 seq=512
2023-11-02T09:46:12Z gateway WARN request_id=rq_3a7f elapsed=30.1s
```
jamie: thanks. Any recent deploys? @deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: deploy event: service=hosting-gateway version=2023.11.02-0f9d8f triggered by @alex at 2023-11-02T09:30:02Z to eu-west cluster. No rollback.
alex: I kicked off a tiny config tweak earlier to change conn_pool to 200 -> 300 for canary. Could that be related?
nate: possible. Runtime pool shows increased queue lengths and KV-cache miss rate rose ~2x starting 09:34. Could be a concurrency cliff with longer seqs (clients sending seq=2048).
olga: are we seeing auth errors or billing rejections for those request IDs? Customer also mentioned random auth failures.
billing-bot: Billing events: customer_id=acme had 0 failed billing attempts. No billing block.
jamie: so not billing. Priya, can you ask customer for a cURL repro that triggers 5xx and one that succeeds? Also ask for model name and sequence length if possible.
priya: asked, customer sent back a repro with long-context prompt; model=redwood-v0, max_tokens=4096, prompt length ~3000 tokens. cURL snippet: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-v0","input":"<huge prompt>","max_tokens":1024}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
nate: large prompt + seq=~4000 will stress KV cache and memory for that runtime flavor. I see memory pressure and occasional OOM restart traces on a subset of pods starting at 09:35. Pod IDs: runtime-7a, runtime-7b.
ajamie: (typo in name) -- ignore
jamie: if pods are restarting, gateway would get upstream 502/504. Can you paste kube events?
nate: kube events snippet: 
```
Warning  OOMKilled  10s  kubelet  container runtime exited with code OOMKilled runtime-7b
Back-off restarting failed container  runtime-7b
```
jamie: immediate mitigation: 1) scale runtime pool by +30% in eu-west, 2) apply circuit-breaker rule to return 429 for requests >3000 token prompt to protect pool, 3) rollback conn_pool change to previous value. I'll take 1+3, @nate take 2?
nate: can do circuit-breaker in gateway config: add rule: 
```
- name: long_context_protect
  match: request.input_tokens > 3000
  action: reject status=429 body="request exceeds safe context length"
```
alex: rolling back conn_pool to 200 now. Ran: `kubectl set env deploy/gateway CONN_POOL=200 --namespace=eu-west`
deploy-bot: rollback complete for service=hosting-gateway version=2023.10.29-7b3c1a in eu-west
jamie: scaling runtime pool: `scale runtime-pool-7 replicas +6`
priya: updated customer about mitigation steps and asked for pause on high-context experiments while we stabilize. Customer acknowledges and paused. :thumbsup:
olga: capturing action items for postmortem: 1) Investigate autoscaling thresholds and memory headroom for runtime flavor 2) Add long-context rejection policy per-region 3) Add observability alert for KV-cache miss spikes 4) Review conn_pool change process (canaries) 5) Customer communication template for auth/timeout escalations. Assign owners?
jamie: I'll own 1 and 4. nate owns 2 and 3. olga owns 5 and will draft comms. priya please coordinate with customer for postmortem review.
priya: noted, scheduling async postmortem review for 2023-11-03 15:00 UTC and tagging customer.
jamie: follow-up: we should also add a testing job that simulates extreme prompt lengths against new gateway config before rollouts. Adding to backlog.
nate: rolled circuit-breaker to canary in eu-west. Patch ID cb-2023.11.02-01. Monitoring for 15m.
deploy-bot: canary rollout complete for circuit-breaker cb-2023.11.02-01 in eu-west (10% traffic)
jamie: initial telemetry: 5xxs dropped to near zero after scale+cb. KV-cache miss rate normalized after restarts finished. Keep monitoring for 1h then we close incident.
priya: customer verified their requests are successful now. I'll close the support ticket once postmortem scheduled.
olga: thanks team. We'll capture root cause as: rapid config change + untested canary + long-context traffic causing memory pressure -> upstream OOM-> gateway 5xx/timeouts. Action items assigned as above. :white_check_mark:
